description: A single filing from the Lantern Arch centerpiece. It has a sharp edge. I carried it in my sleeve for three days before remembering it. It feels heavier than it looks, and it is still stained with the light from the room where I found it.
role_link_note: Metal filings drop where the Blacksmith works the new Lantern Arch centerpiece — at the bench in town and under the Arch itself.
